subject: Render values of a data frame?

messages.author: d3e2e3c09c385ed8
messages.subject: Render values of a data frame?
parts:
Hi,

Suppose I have a function that takes an input an returns a data frame with two values. I want to render the following text: Value 1 is `df1$value1`, and value 2 is `df1$value2`. Is there a way of doing this?


This is the code that I have right now:

## app.R ##
library(shinydashboard)

ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(title = "Basic dashboard"),
  dashboardSidebar(),
  dashboardBody(
    # Boxes need to be put in a row (or column)
    fluidRow(
      box(renderText(paste('Value 1 is', "df1$value1"))),
      
      box(
        title = "Controls",
        sliderInput("slider", "X:", 1, 100, 50)
      )
    )
  )
)

my.func <- function(X){
  df1 = data.frame(value1=X*X, value2=sqrt(X))
  return(df1)
}

server <- function(input, output) {

  output$df1 <- renderTable({
    my.func(input$slider)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)


Thanks!

  df1 <- reactive({
    x <- input$slider
    data.frame(value1=x*x, value2=sqrt(x))
  })
  output$text1 <- renderText({
    paste("Value 1 is", df1()$value1)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

messages.subject: Re: Render values of a data frame?
parts:
You would change textOutput to uiOutput and change the output$text1 definition to:

output$text1 <- renderUI({
  list("Value 1 is", strong(df1()$value1))
})

See http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/html-tags.html for more info on what can go into renderUI.
